searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, life/PROFILE.md, profile.md, and data/target-companies.json, then attempted to verify candidates (Databricks APM New Grad 2027, Nvidia Solutions Architect New College Grad, Scale AI Strategic Projects Lead, Meta RPM, Cohere/Ramp/Harvey boards, Hugging Face) via WebFetch. This session's network policy resolved only anthropic.com (which currently has no new-grad-eligible SE/FDE/TPM req per target-companies.json) and rejected every other target domain with ENOTFOUND (databricks.com, nvidia.com, scale.com, metacareers.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.lever.co, apply.workable.com, openai.com, google.com, linkedin.com) — confirmed systemic via the proxy status endpoint, not a one-off DNS blip. WebSearch still worked and surfaced plausible candidates (e.g. Databricks APM New Grad 2027 Start), but hunt.md's verification rule requires actually fetching and confirming the live page before including anything, and that was not possible for any candidate today. Writing zero opportunities rather than including unverified search snippets.
